description: "Complete Project Gutenberg Works of Oliver Wendell Holmes, Sr." by Oliver Wendell Holmes Sr. is a collection of literary and scientific essays written during the mid-19th century. This anthology includes works like "The Autocrat of the Breakfast Table" and various medical essays, reflecting Holmes's intellect and wit as he explores themes of society, literature, and the human condition through a conversational and personal lens.
